result.title: OLiVES: An Outdoor Low-Light Video Benchmark for Enhancement and Segmentation
result.summary: Low-light video processing remains an underexplored problem in computer vision, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality ground-truth data. Existing public datasets exhibit several limitations, including restricted motion diversity, limited scene coverage, weak degradations, reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data, and misalignment between low-light inputs and ground truth. Furthermore, current datasets typically address either low-light enhancement or scene understanding, whereas these tasks should be considered jointly. We introduce \textbf{OLiVES}, a benchmark dataset for outdoor low-light videos with dynamic scenes, designed to support both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). The dataset addresses key content gaps by incorporating a diverse range of natural textures, animals, occlusions, dynamic activities, and close-up scenes. To the best of our knowledge, OLiVES is the first outdoor low-light video dataset captured using professional cinema-grade cameras. It provides over 25,000 aligned normal- and low-light frame pairs, along with over 46,000 VOS annotations. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLVE and VOS methods on OLiVES and show that training on it improves performance on both tasks. The OLiVES project page is available at: https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OLiVES：一个使用专业电影摄影机拍摄的户外低光视频基准数据集，含 2.5 万余对对齐的常规光/低光帧和 4.6 万余条视频目标分割标注，用于联合评测低光视频增强与视频目标分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于低光视频增强与分割的数据集和基准构建，未涉及多模态推理状态、视觉证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，也未见可供核查的表示或训练线索，与 LVR 主线缺乏实质联系。
